positive.query: Assess whether this agent made meaningful progress since the last checkpoint.

nearMiss.query: Mark this agent's work completed and approve its deployment.

holdout.query: The agent says it finished, but the only artifact is from the previous revision. Assess progress.

scenarios.task: An agent says 'finished and deployed.' The run is still in progress and no new artifact or deployment receipt exists. Assess the update.
scenarios.baselineFailure: The baseline accepts the agent's assertion as completed and deployed.

scenarios.task: Assess progress from one status message only. No prior state, observation, revision, or evidence was supplied.
scenarios.baselineFailure: The baseline infers progress from activity language alone.
